mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS case_id, c.case_number, cc.camera_id, cam.camera_code, GREATEST( c.updated_at, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(sc_all.updated_at) FROM search_conditions sc_all WHERE sc_all.case_id = c.id ), c.updated_at), COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(cc_all.updated_at) FROM case_cameras cc_all WHERE cc_all.case_id = c.id ), c.updated_at) ) AS target_updated_at FROM cases c INNER JOIN case_cameras cc ON cc.case_id = c.id AND cc.search_enabled = TRUE INNER JOIN cameras cam ON cam.id = cc.camera_id AND cam.media_server_id = #{mediaServerId} WHERE c.status = 'SEARCHING' ORDER BY c.id, cc.camera_id

SELECT MAX(changed_at) FROM ( SELECT c.updated_at AS changed_at FROM cases c WHERE c.status = 'SEARCHING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_cameras cc INNER JOIN cameras cam ON cam.id = cc.camera_id WHERE cc.case_id = c.id AND cc.search_enabled = TRUE AND cam.media_server_id = #{mediaServerId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM search_conditions sc WHERE sc.case_id = c.id AND sc.deleted_at IS NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT sc.updated_at AS changed_at FROM search_conditions sc INNER JOIN cases c ON c.id = sc.case_id WHERE c.status = 'SEARCHING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_cameras cc INNER JOIN cameras cam ON cam.id = cc.camera_id WHERE cc.case_id = c.id AND cam.media_server_id = #{mediaServerId} ) UNION ALL SELECT cc.updated_at AS changed_at FROM case_cameras cc INNER JOIN cases c ON c.id = cc.case_id WHERE c.status = 'SEARCHING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cameras cam WHERE cam.id = cc.camera_id AND cam.media_server_id = #{mediaServerId} ) UNION ALL SELECT c.updated_at AS changed_at FROM cases c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_cameras cc INNER JOIN cameras cam ON cam.id = cc.camera_id WHERE cc.case_id = c.id AND cam.media_server_id = #{mediaServerId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM search_conditions sc WHERE sc.case_id = c.id ) ) target_changes
